title: CareEye: AI-Based Facial Pain Detection System
desc: CareEye is an AI-based healthcare assistance system designed to detect possible pain expressions from patients' facial images in real time. The system combines computer vision and deep learning with a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B. A camera captures live facial images, OpenCV and Haar Cascade are used for face detection and preprocessing, and a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classifies facial expressions into Pain and No Pain. The system performs local processing to support privacy, reduce latency, and enable practical healthcare monitoring.
